title: Guides — Practical Playbooks for Portaless, TypeScript & AI · Geroi Loyola
description: Step-by-step playbooks: installing and mastering Portaless (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, Docker, /admin/editor), modular TypeScript, MCP agents, and strict CSP.

props.title: Guides — Hands-on engineering playbooks
props.subtitle: Direct, practical guides to deploy and master Portaless, structure decoupled TypeScript packages, connect MCP agents, and enforce strict CSP in production.

props.items:
server :: 1. Deploy free on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages :: Fork the repo, customize site-profiles/starter/, and ship static HTML with strict CSP (A-07). Add Cloudflare Pages + D1 or Docker self-hosting when you want the dynamic runtime and Trust Layer. :: span=2 :: featured
package :: 2. Visual Editor (/admin/editor) :: Edit your home page and subpages with all 17 Visual Elements (Bento Grid, Columns, Hero, PostList) without hand-coding HTML.
shield :: 3. ThemePack v2 Light/Dark :: Declare lightVars, darkVars, and editorial tokens (--font-display, --space-section, --elevation) checked against WCAG AA >= 4.5:1.
bot :: 4. AI Agents via native MCP (19 tools) :: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client under atomic permissions to create pages, edit blocks, and switch themes with real audit trails. :: span=2 :: featured

package :: TypeScript & repository boundaries :: How to split a monorepo into standalone packages with automated import boundary checks and zero cycles.
shield :: Strict CSP without unsafe-inline :: Removing inline scripts and inline styles without sacrificing interactivity (theme toggle, navigation, and forms).
bot :: Web Bot Auth & Local Trust Protocol :: Verifying did:apw identity and cryptographic agent signatures using @verared/*.
